notes: Canonical composition: SettingsGroup + SettingsRow stacks in SettingsPanel sections (e.g. Providers, Users).
Domain accordion disclosure is NOT duplicated — see domains-accordion parity target.
settings-row parity covers row shell; this target covers grouped section chrome (title, description, bordered body).
Synthetic labels only; no credentials, private IDs, runtime URLs, or server payloads.

labels.groupDescription: Credentials are write-only; values are never displayed.

geometry.layout: group title + optional description above bordered rounded body
geometry.density: SettingsRow px-3.5 py-2.5 inside group; separator hairlines between rows

expectedTokenGeometry: Body uses rounded border and inset shadow

r10.keyboardTouch: row controls inside group remain keyboard reachable via settings-row
r10.focus: group title is presentational; focus lands on row controls
r10.screenReader: group heading text and row labels present
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: status slot hosts StatusPill in row children
r10.zoom: group title and row labels remain present
r10.darkLight: render under data-theme zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: group body spans full width; rows stack on narrow via settings-row grid
